name: sol10-pill-context
goal: Retain the real Desktop stylesheet and painted chip treatment in the shared Pill catalog state.

evidence: The 9b API chip images show plain text. Pill chip uses Desktop workspace chip styles, but catalogEntry chooses Reports styles from the unit id.
The existing catalog chip case checked its class, text and fitted width, but not painted border or padding. Strengthen that same state at all three viewports.
Formal red record c77868eded3c79045b8faafd56bad63b69222e5a4ad26d79312dee78014e9c60: the unchanged Pill chip assertions fail with paddingLeft 0 at all three viewports.
Use the real Desktop caller stylesheet for the shared Pill chip variant. The existing three-viewport catalog case now requires positive painted padding.
catalogEntry selects the existing Desktop styles for the shared chip variant and reuses the parsed query parameters. No Pill implementation or design tokens changed.
